news.title: Major Infrastructure Project Announced for Highway Expansion in Uttar Pradesh
news.content: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has cleared a major budget for phase 3 of the corridor expansion.
news.explanation: Verified directly with Ministry of Road Transport and Highways official press release #MoRTH-2026-09.

news.title: Claims of New Currency Notes Starting from Next Month Found to be Fabricated
news.content: Viral messages on WhatsApp claiming the RBI is issuing new ₹5000 notes are completely false.
news.explanation: Debunked by Reserve Bank of India and Press Information Bureau official release. No such currency exists.

news.title: Tech Innovation Hub Setup Planned in Bengaluru by Global Tech Giant
news.content: A leading Silicon Valley company is in final stages of signing an MOU for a 50-acre R&D campus.
news.explanation: Confirmed through State IT Ministry statements and corporate investor relations disclosures.

news.title: Controversial Video Clip from Recent Rally Shared Out of Context
news.content: A video clip circulating widely shows a leader making a statement; however, the full video reveals a different context.
news.explanation: Video editing omitted the preceding 45 seconds of qualifying speech, altering the contextual meaning.
